ATTRITION_BRAKE.instruction: Recent observed losses exceed military progress or force dropped sharply. Break the losing cycle: regroup, reinforce, preserve force, and avoid repeating an unproductive pressure pattern.

BALANCED_SEARCH.instruction: No emergency condition is proven. Balance scouting, reinforcement, economy, and positioning from current observations. Aggression is not a quota; choose one currently offered action with a measurable objective.

CONTACT_RESPONSE.instruction: An enemy is currently visible while usable force exists. Prefer a deliberate currently offered tactical movement or targeting action over unrelated activity, while avoiding blind pursuit beyond observed evidence.

ENGAGEMENT_DEFICIT.instruction: A usable force remains passive without observed military progress. Reacquire contact with a currently offered scouting, movement, or positioning action; do not accumulate irrelevant production indefinitely and do not invent hidden targets.

FORCE_CONVERSION.instruction: A rebuilt force is available, repeated blind attack-move has produced no observed contact or military progress, and the last generation detected this condition without breaking the action loop. Do not choose attack_move again this round when any other currently offered action can deliberately change position, scouting, formation, or force readiness. If move_units is currently offered, prefer move_units for a deliberate reposition/reacquisition action. Keep the tool surface unchanged, use no hidden state, and resume focused engagement only after observed contact.

MEASURED_CONTACT.instruction: Contact is active. Maintain pressure only while observed trades, force survival, or positional progress justify it; prefer focused targeting or controlled repositioning over reflexive repetition.

REBUILD_FORCE.instruction: Observed combat force is below the engagement floor. Preserve survivors and rebuild a usable force before spending scarce units on unsupported pressure.
